content.title: Lucid (LCID): Revenue Forecast to Grow 44.6% Annually, But Losses Persist Ahead of Earnings
content.summary: Lucid Group (LCID) remains unprofitable, with losses increasing at an average annual rate of 2.6% over the past five years, and is expected to stay in the red for at least the next three. Despite these ongoing losses, Wall Street has its eye on Lucid’s projected revenue growth of 44.6% per year, far outpacing the broader US market’s 10.4% growth forecast.
